answer: Trust-graph flow analysis curbs Sybil attacks by bounding algorithmic credit along graph cuts rooted at verified seeds. An attacker incurs the verifiable cost of acquiring scarce social capital or bribing reputable peers to vouch for each persona. Whether an agent trades timber, monitors walnut yields, or manages a shale quarry, reputation attenuates sharply across unvouched edges. However, this topology inherently favors incumbent clusters, penalizing nascent honest nodes.
